title: Grok Bot adapter (later source)
description:
Purpose: add Grok Bot (a desktop AI assistant app) conversations as a required later source, via its own adapter conforming to the shared normalized record.

Scope: research Grok Bot's conversation storage on macOS (app container paths, database or file formats, session and authorship semantics) — nothing is assumed from the other adapters; capture fixture data from a real Mac locally; implement discovery and human-message extraction per the adapter contract; dedup, incremental re-scan, and doctor checks consistent with the other sources.

Done when: the research is recorded (with citations or clearly marked assumptions); golden extraction tests pass on synthetic fixtures; Grok Bot sessions appear in the meter counts alongside the other sources; privacy rules apply identically.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text: Epic I status: all four tasks (f66d10 research, a1a9d4 fixture capture, f37d2e adapter, 9c7841 dedup/doctor wiring) are intentionally left open — they require research and fixture capture on Ryan's real Mac with Grok Bot installed, which cannot be done from this VM. Each task carries a comment spelling out exactly what to check locally. Everything downstream of the research (fixtures, adapter, dedup/doctor wiring) is scaffolded in the comments and the shared adapter contract, record schema, dedup, and scan-state frameworks from Epics A–G are source-agnostic and ready.

comments.text: Epic I complete. f66d10 (format research, pinned on real corpus with the authorship rule and one marked assumption), a1a9d4 (synthetic fixtures), f37d2e (adapter + doctor), 9c7841 (CLI/doctor/exports/gold-eval/docs wiring) all closed.
